summary: td is a Go 1.25 CLI application built with Cobra for command dispatch, SQLite for persistence, and charmbracelet/bubbletea for its terminal UI. It features a custom query language (TDQ), multi-device sync via a standalone HTTP server, and a Docusaurus documentation website.

core_frameworks.name: charmbracelet/bubbletea
core_frameworks.purpose: Elm-architecture TUI framework - Model/Update/View pattern for the monitor
core_frameworks.usage: pkg/monitor/ - entire TUI is built on this

core_frameworks.name: charmbracelet/lipgloss
core_frameworks.purpose: Terminal styling - borders, colors, layout, JoinHorizontal/Vertical

core_frameworks.name: spf13/cobra
core_frameworks.purpose: CLI command framework - subcommand routing, flags, help generation

core_frameworks.name: mattn/go-sqlite3
core_frameworks.purpose: CGo SQLite3 driver (primary, used via database/sql)

core_frameworks.name: modernc.org/sqlite
core_frameworks.purpose: Pure-Go SQLite driver (CGo-free alternative for cross-compilation)

internal_systems.name: TDQ (td Query Language)
internal_systems.description: Custom query language with lexer, parser, and evaluator. Supports field comparisons, boolean logic, functions (has, is, any, blocks, blocked_by, descendant_of, rework, stale), date arithmetic, and label matching.

internal_systems.name: Sync Engine
internal_systems.description: Multi-device sync protocol with event sourcing, conflict resolution (last-writer-wins with vector clocks), and a standalone HTTP sync server (cmd/td-sync/).

internal_systems.name: Session Management
internal_systems.description: DB-backed session tracking scoped by terminal/agent context. Enforces session isolation for review workflow (implementer cannot approve own work).

internal_systems.name: Admin API
internal_systems.description: HTTP API for the sync server with endpoints for users, projects, events, snapshots, and administration.

internal_systems.name: Modal System
internal_systems.description: Declarative modal framework with stacking support, sections, inputs, lists, and consistent layout patterns.

internal_systems.name: Keymap System
internal_systems.description: Context-based keybinding registry with configurable bindings, sidecar export, and context-sensitive help generation.

internal_systems.name: Mouse Support
internal_systems.description: Mouse click/scroll handling for TUI panels and navigation.

build_system.dual_sqlite: CGo (mattn/go-sqlite3) and pure-Go (modernc.org/sqlite) via build tags

testing.notable: Custom E2E engine simulating concurrent agent sessions with chaos testing

architectural_patterns: Command Pattern (Cobra CLI + keymap command dispatch)
State Machine (issue lifecycle: open → in_progress → in_review → closed)
Observer Pattern (async tea.Cmd for data refresh)
Strategy Pattern (dual SQLite drivers via build tags)
Declarative UI (modal system with section builders)
